title: Historical automated-backlog depth remediation: measurement companion

snapshot.working_tree_state: Implementation revision 51e35fbcb50151590604611f10910a7fd13660e4 contains the cumulative-evidence recovery and is the latest committed revision with a full 14-project matrix. It fixes the live-observed PowerShell-read, same-session evidence-loss, and proof-verifier integration defects and durably binds every reused source to its attempt, case, revision, workspace, session, events, and signed-in Codex receipt. Complete bound replay reduced the retained case from 30 findings to five with zero model calls: two primary evidence gaps and three dependent findings. Complete affected suites pass; the canonical matrix passed on unchanged Python code/test bytes in 1,334.835 seconds and lint passed 14 of 14 in 55.071 seconds. This metrics refresh is documentation-only. No live end-to-end cycle has completed.

boundary_replay.interpretation: Two findings are primary missing-read gaps; three are deterministic causal/falsification consequences of incomplete mechanism coverage. This replay is development evidence on a stopped cycle, not an accepted dossier or qualification result.

scope.included: Automated atom-derived problem mining, research, optioning, planning, shadow qualification, export readiness, and outcome tracking.
scope.excluded: IDEA and other externally originated work as sources of new automated cases.
scope.primary_objective: Mine real unactioned problems, establish their causal mechanisms, plan solutions that close those mechanisms, and prove the original problems were resolved.

interpretation.unknown_policy: Unknown and not-measured values are not converted to zero percent.
